title: Forecasting threshold exceedance of atmospheric variables at a specific location
abstract: arXiv:2605.31079v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate short-term forecasting of extreme weather events is important for early warning and risk mitigation. We compare two approaches for predicting site-specific threshold exceedances of weather variables: direct binary probabilistic models trained on thresholded outcomes and full-distribution parametric models trained on the continuous target. Using an analytically tractable Gaussian random-location model, in which the distribution is predictably shifted by the covariates, we quantify the consequences of the information loss induced by thresholding and derive the rare-event behavior of prediction errors and forecast skill. The analysis predicts an increasing relative advantage of the full-distribution approach as event probability decreases, because binarization progressively discards information contained in the continuous response. translated_title: 特定地点大气变量阈值超越事件的预报
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.31079v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：对极端天气事件进行准确的短期预报对于早期预警和风险减缓至关重要。我们比较了预测特定地点天气变量阈值超越事件的两种方法：一种是在阈值化结果上训练的直接二元概率模型，另一种是在连续目标上训练的全分布参数模型。利用一个解析可处理的高斯随机位置模型（其中分布会被协变量可预测地平移），我们量化了阈值化所导致的信息损失的后果，并推导出稀有事件情形下预测误差和预报技巧的行为。该分析表明，随着事件概率的降低，全分布方法的相对优势会不断增加，因为二元化会逐步丢弃连续响应中所包含的信息。随后，我们在多个地点比较了这两种方法在预报风速和累积降水量方面的表现。
tldr: 该论文通过解析可处理的高斯模型理论和风速、降水的实际预报实验证明，基于连续目标训练的全分布参数模型在预测特定地点天气变量阈值超越事件时优于直接在阈值化结果上训练的二元概率模型，且事件越稀有这种优势越显著。
en_tdlr: Full-distribution parametric models trained on continuous targets outperform directly trained binary probabilistic models for forecasting site-specific threshold exceedances of weather variables, with the relative advantage increasing as events become rarer.
